title: Support Engineer
description:
About Artemis

At Artemis (artemispower.com), we're on a mission to accelerate the adoption of solar, storage, EV charging, and home improvements by making them more accessible, transparent, and affordable. Founded in 2022, we're a venture-backed climate tech company using machine learning and AI to reinvent how homeowners upgrade their homes - a market orders of magnitude bigger than solar alone. Our platform generates instant, accurate proposals and streamlines the sales process for homeowners and installers alike.

We're a fast-growing, dynamic startup moving quickly - shipping new products, entering adjacent categories, and expanding the platform every quarter. If you want broad surface area, fast feedback loops, and real ownership, this is the place.

Our values

•
Challenge Assumptions. Creatively find better ways of working.

•
Stop, Look, Listen, and Smell. Pay attention before you act - gather context, read the room.

•
Move Fast. Thoughtfully prioritize work.

•
Be Scrappy. View problems as opportunities; stay lean.

•
Always be Learning. Stay curious; invest in your craft.

•
Do the Right Thing. Keep commitments, close the loop.

The role

Support Engineers sit at L2 in our support stack - L1 (Technical Support Representatives) handle direct customer contact, you're the technical responder they lean on, and L3 (senior engineers) is where you escalate when a problem needs deeper investigation. You'll run technical investigations, ship bug fixes, and keep L1 unblocked so customers stay unblocked. Because support touches every part of the product, you'll build broad familiarity across the codebase and work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.

The shift for this position is 3PM-11PM ET weekdays, with on-call every other Saturday 10am-3pm ET.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as the primary technical responder on your assigned support shifts - this is an L2 role, so most tickets reach you via escalation from L1, not directly from customers.

• Support our L1 Technical Support Representatives with technical context, reproduction steps, and answers that unblock their customer conversations.

• Run technical investigations on escalated issues and ship bug fixes end-to-end - scrappy, not sloppy.

• Escalate to L3 (senior engineers) when a problem needs deeper investigation, and time-box your own digs.

• Identify recurring issues across tickets, propose broader fixes, and suggest metrics that improve visibility on high-impact problems.

• Partner with Customer Success and Product to turn customer context into the right fix.

• Document findings, write knowledge-base articles, and leave the code better than you found it.

Required qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in an engineering or technical support role in a B2B SaaS environment.

• Comfortable in a modern web stack - Next.js, React, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.

• Working knowledge of SQL and a scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar).

• Hands-on with testing and monitoring tools like Postman, PostHog, CloudWatch, Sentry, or equivalents.

• Experience with support ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira, Linear, or similar).

• Strong written communication - you can explain a technical problem to both a customer and a senior engineer.

• Thrives in a fast-moving, dynamic startup environment - comfortable with shifting priorities and ambiguity.

• Hands-on experience with AI development tools and workflow (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) for investigation, debugging, and shipping fixes faster.

What we offer

• Fully remote work.

• Stock options.

• Health benefits.

• Paid time off and vacations.

• Annual tech allowance.

• Professional development through courses, seminars, and certifications.

Interested? Email your resume to - a short note on why you're drawn to the role helps us move fast.

title: Sr. Specialist, Advanced Analytics
description:
The Sr. Specialist, Advanced Analytics is a seasoned expert in statistical modeling, machine learning, and predictive analytics who operates with a high degree of autonomy to design, build, and deploy sophisticated analytical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of advanced models - including customer lifetime value, churn prediction, propensity modeling, and advanced segmentation - and serves as a trusted analytical advisor to business stakeholders and senior leadership. The Sr. Specialist is expected to bring deep technical mastery combined with strong business judgment, translating ambiguous business problems into well-defined analytical frameworks and translating complex model outputs into clear, actionable strategic recommendations. This individual also plays a key role in elevating the capability of the broader analytics team through mentorship, best-practice development, and technical leadership.
Here’s what you’ll do:

• Lead the full analytical project lifecycle - from problem framing and data exploration through model development, validation, deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring.

• Partner directly with business stakeholders and cross-functional leaders to identify high-value analytical opportunities, scope projects, and align modeling approaches with strategic business objectives.

• Translate complex statistical and machine learning outputs into clear, non-technical narratives and actionable recommendations for executive and business audiences.

• Proactively identify data quality issues, model drift, or emerging risks in production models and lead remediation efforts.

• Independently design, develop, and deploy advanced predictive and machine learning models (e.g., customer lifetime value, churn, propensity-to-buy, next-best-action, advanced segmentation) with minimal oversight.

• Establish and maintain model governance practices, including documentation, validation standards, and monitoring frameworks to ensure models remain accurate and reliable in production.

• Mentor and coach junior and mid-level analysts on statistical techniques, coding best practices, model validation methods, and business communication skills.

• Lead or significantly contribute to large, cross-team analytical initiatives, often coordinating work across multiple contributors and stakeholders.

• Stay current on emerging SnowFlake, SQL, Databricks, emerging AI and machine learning techniques, tools, and industry best practices, and champion their adoption where relevant.

• Collaborate with data engineering and IT teams to ensure analytical infrastructure, data pipelines, and tooling support scalable model development and deployment.

• Present findings, methodologies, and business impact to senior leadership and various cross-functional partners.
What you’ll need to be successful:

• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field required; Master's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

• 3 - 5 years of progressive experience in statistical modeling, predictive analytics, or data science, with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex analytical solutions.

• Advanced, demonstrated expertise in machine learning algorithms (e.g., gradient boosting, random forests, clustering, survival analysis) and statistical modeling techniques.

• Expert-level proficiency in R and/or Python, with strong SQL skills; experience with cloud-based or enterprise analytical infrastructure strongly preferred.

• Proven experience building and deploying customer lifetime value, churn, and segmentation models in a production business environment.

• Strong business acumen with the demonstrated ability to translate complex analytical findings into strategic, actionable business recommendations.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior business stakeholders

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are coming together with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together we're building the data infrastructure layer that moves, transforms, and adds context to data - from the moment it lands to the point where teams and AI systems depend on it.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products our customers know and trust. It's a good time to join a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work.

About the Role

Product Finance covers two things: how our products perform, and what they cost to build, run, and support. This role owns the cost and investment side, as the finance partner to the Product and Customer Support organizations.

You'll own the operating expense P&L for both organizations - headcount and hiring plans, vendor and program spend, annual planning, monthly close, and budget-vs-actuals - and work with those leaders on where to spend and what to trade off.

You'll also build our view of product investment at the portfolio level: what we spend behind each product line, what it returns, and what that means for how the roadmap gets funded. That includes bringing cost of revenue and unit economics into the picture, so we can talk about product margin rather than just product spend. This is how we'll decide where to invest and where to pull back.

You'll build our cost-to-serve view as well - support cost by account and segment, and the economics of deflection and AI-assisted support.

Expect close work with Product Managers, Support and Engineering leaders, Pricing, Corporate FP&A, and Accounting, and regular exposure to senior leadership as we scale toward public company readiness.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in our New York, NY office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What You'll Do

• Serve as the finance business partner to Product and Customer Support leadership - own their budgets, partner on spend decisions, and flag risks, trade-offs, and reallocation opportunities early.

• Own the annual operating plan for both organizations, including headcount and hiring plans, vendor and program spend, and quarterly reforecasts.

• Own monthly close, accruals, and variance analysis - budget vs. actuals with clear driver explanations and forward-looking implications.

• Build the portfolio view of product investment: what we spend behind each product line, what it returns, and what that implies for roadmap funding and resource allocation.

• Bring cost of revenue and product unit economics into that view, working with the teams that own the underlying cost data.

• Build cost-to-serve analytics - support cost by account and segment, and the economics of deflection and AI-assisted support.

• Build business cases for new product investments and major roadmap decisions, including the economics of retiring or consolidating products, and provide Pricing with the unit economics behind packaging and monetization changes.

• Co-own the Product Monthly and Quarterly Financial Reviews with the product top-line lead, so cost and performance are presented together.

• Improve how this work gets done - better data models, less manual assembly, and AI applied to recurring analysis.

What We're Looking For

title: Senior Software Developer, Dataplane Adapters
description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model - it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.
Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide - including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more - have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.
So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology-and your hard work!
About the Role
We at Solace believe we build the world's best event broker - the backbone of real-time business, trusted to move billions of messages a day across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments with unmatched reliability and performance.
At the heart of the Solace Event Broker lies the Datapath - the engine responsible for moving messages at high rate, with low latency and utmost reliability. The Dataplane Adapters team owns the protocol surface: the MQTT, AMQP, REST, RDP, and Kafka adapters that let clients and applications connect, publish, and consume messages. This work spans our custom hardware appliance - built around FPGAs and a Cavium network processor - and our software broker running on Intel server processors. The code is highly multi-threaded and performance-oriented, and our developers regularly go deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals to deliver features that meet our strict performance and reliability bar.
This position is for a Senior Software Developer on the Dataplane Adapters team. In this role you will be a key technical leader who contributes to the architecture of our protocol adapters and leads the design and delivery of the most complex features for how clients connect to the broker. You will shape technical direction across the hardware and software platforms, mentor other developers, represent the team with customers and other R&D groups, and be a go-to person for the hardest performance and field problems. Your expertise will shape how the world's largest enterprises move their most critical data.
Are You Someone Who:

• Has a passion for high-performance systems with a deep understanding of multi-threaded C++, TCP/IP, and the Linux kernel?

• Thrives on solving complex protocol and performance challenges in distributed messaging systems?

• Has experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems?

• Enjoys mentoring and leading technical teams while contributing to architectural decisions?

• Values craftsmanship, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer experiences?

• Is humble, honest and open?

What You'll Do:

• Lead Adapter Design: Contribute to the architecture of our protocol adapters, lead the design and technical delivery of the most complex features across the hardware appliance and software broker, and own the technical decisions within those features

• Drive Technical Innovation: Research and prototype new protocol features, networking techniques, and performance approaches to keep the Solace datapath ahead of the industry

• Develop Core Platform Features: Design and build the most complex, performance-critical adapter features in multi-threaded C++, going deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals when needed

• Mentor and Lead: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to intermediate and junior developers, lead design and code reviews, and establish best practices for the team, including how we use AI-assisted development in performance-critical code

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with product management,

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: Software Engineering Manager

At FMX , our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high-performing, inclusive engineering culture.
This is a player-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non-mission-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. You’ll also help shape how FMX builds software in an AI-first world, setting the practices, tools, and standards that help our engineers ship faster without lowering the bar on quality.

Lead and grow your team: Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career guidance, and advocate for each person’s professional and technical growth.

•
Build a strong culture: Foster trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel valued, heard, and connected to FMX ’s mission. Keep the team engaged with challenging, meaningful problems and help them see the customer impact of their work.

•
Clear the path: Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction.

•
Stay technical: Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness.

•

• 2-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS.

• Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross-functional collaboration.

• The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day-to-day execution.

• A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience.

title: Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation
description:
Company Description
Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.
We are seeking an experienced Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation to build and lead a modern enterprise quality capability across Zayo’s technology organization. This role will be accountable for improving the reliability, predictability, and speed of technology delivery while providing independent assurance for critical business platforms, transformational programs, and AI-enabled solutions.
The successful candidate will combine deep quality engineering expertise with strong enterprise leadership, bringing a risk-based, automation-first approach to how quality is embedded across the software delivery lifecycle. The role will also shape how Zayo evaluates and governs emerging agentic AI capabilities, ensuring they are reliable, controlled, and ready for enterprise-scale adoption.

This is a highly collaborative and transformational leadership role, partnering across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data and AI, Operations, and business teams to strengthen quality outcomes, reduce production risk, and establish a culture of measurable engineering excellence.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead Zayo’s enterprise quality engineering strategy, operating model, roadmap, service catalog, standards, and governance.

• Own the enterprise quality engineering platform, including Tosca, qTest, automation assets, integrations, test execution infrastructure, quality reporting, and AI-evaluation capabilities.

• Establish risk-based quality models, release-readiness criteria, quality gates, certification standards, and evidence requirements for critical platforms, business processes, integrations, data products, and AI agents.

• Lead a centralized quality engineering service that plans, automates, executes, and governs testing across enterprise products, platforms, programs, and high-risk releases.

• Develop reusable automation frameworks, model-based testing patterns, API and integration testing capabilities, regression suites, and continuous testing practices aligned to business risk and production impact.

• Establish enterprise capabilities for AI-agent evaluation, including scenario design, evaluation datasets, regression testing, tool-use validation, policy and permission checks, human escalation criteria, and production quality monitoring.

• Own the enterprise approach to test data, test environments, service virtualization, production validation, and quality analytics to reduce release risk and delivery delays.

• Provide independent quality intelligence and release-risk assessments to engineering, product, program, and executive stakeholders.

• Manage vendor-outsourced quality engineering resources, Tricentis partners, systems integrators, and specialist testing providers to deliver sustained enterprise quality outcomes.

• Build a quality engineering culture focused on automation, objective assurance, reuse, engineering discipline, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

About the job

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

• Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.

• Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

Location: Remote

About Paloma
In 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years for these assessments. Delayed assessments result in children being more likely to develop mental health conditions and fall behind in education. Furthermore, the much-needed pre/post-assessment support (outside of ADHD medications) is typically not funded by the NHS.
These long waits have built up due to increased recognition and understanding of neurodevelopmental conditions and a lack of investment and innovation within the NHS to meet the growing demand.
Mark and Darshak, with their 25 years of combined NHS experience, including building services that have treated over 1,000,000 patients in obesity & ophthalmology, founded Paloma to change this. Our mission is to make NHS autism and ADHD assessments and care accessible within 4 weeks of a GP referral, and, in turn, help every child achieve their potential.
As of May 2026, we have successfully reduced waits to 3 months by;

• Taking a product-first approach to redesign the care pathway to give families a more consumer-like experience of care

• Our in-house product, engineering and AI team building our own autism and ADHD specific electronic patient record and AI documentation tool to free clinicians from their significant documentation burden to re-focus on supporting families

• Investing in expanding the clinician workforce and upskilling them in new ways of working.

We are proud that Paloma is:

• Loved by families, with 4.9 out of 5 Trustpilot and Google ratings

• Care Quality Commission (CQC) registered and quality-focused

• Clinically-led, with a team of 130 people, including over 80 clinicians supporting families through their assessment journey. We are hiring 100+ more roles over the next 12 months.

• A community of passionate, mission-driven and innovative team members who challenge the status quo and test and learn from new ideas and approaches.

• Backed by leading healthcare investors Triple Point and Heal Capital

What’s next?

• Whilst we have reduced wait times, it is estimated that up to 500,000 children are still waiting for an NHS autism or ADHD assessment. We won’t rest until this comes down.

• We want to build new services to support families and children diagnosed with autism or ADHD who feel lost after their assessments when the NHS is no longer there for them.

• Have built our own technology & AI tools to gather the required information from families, and support your documentation, so you can focus on children’s needs

This role will ensure we deliver a fantastic Children’s Autism and ADHD assessment service to families.
We commit to supporting your development and well-being, including:

• The Paloma Clinical Academy programme supports all clinicians at all stages of their careers to develop (e.g. to our Senior Assessor role) and cross-skill (e.g. in autism)

• Regular clinical supervision

title: Social Media Intelligence Analyst
description:
Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.

Position Summary:

Magna Legal Services is seeking a Social Media Intelligence Analyst to join our team! In this role, you will assist us in helping to either verify or disprove the claims that the other side is making in their lawsuit/insurance claim. In other words, you will be using social media to search for the truth, whatever it may be. Our ideal candidate will be an experienced social media user who is tech savvy, with relevant experience in the legal field. Strong preference will be given to anyone who has experience with social media investigations, open source searching and/or experience with the legal discovery process. Additionally, this position can help you qualify to become a licensed Private Investigator; if you are not one already, and if that is something that you’re interested in pursuing.

Key Responsibilities:

• Finding and verifying social media accounts.

• Reviewing content from social media accounts.

• Performing Open Source Intelligence (OSINT)/Deep Internet Searching.

• Quickly analyzing the information located.

Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Criminal Justice, Psychology, Communications, etc.

• At least 2 years of relevant work experience (i.e., working as an investigator, a paralegal or law clerk, an investigative reporter, law enforcement, etc.) is preferred.

• In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, an associate’s degree with at least 3 years of relevant work experience, and with a current private investigator’s license and/or certifications in Social Media/Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) may be considered.

• Must be tech savvy and a regular user on multiple social media platforms.

• Must be comfortable working independently and collaborating with team members.

At Supabase, TAMs are the technical owners of their assigned accounts, working closely with our most valuable customers to:

- Validate deployments and guide customers through onboarding and early success.

- Proactively surface risks and optimization opportunities before they become incidents.

- Coordinate internal teams on complex escalations and drive root cause analysis.

- Align Supabase capabilities with the customer’s roadmap.

Successful TAMs are proactive, technically credible, and customer-first. TAM is a relationship, not a response channel: you’ll act as an extension of your customers’ teams and advocate on their behalf within Supabase.

You’ll be joining our Success team, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility:

Escalation & Collaboration

Serve as the voice of the customer to Engineering and Product, sharing specific, reproducible feedback on recurring pain points and taking part in beta and early access programs.

Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account health and retention, with technical input on renewals, expansions, and evaluations, and early flags on risks to satisfaction.

Awareness of how TAM performance shows up in retention and NRR, including surfacing expansion signals and renewal risks early.

Experience working in async or globally distributed teams.

title: Senior Decision Scientist, Sales
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

SALES HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

- What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

- Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

- The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

- A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Decision Scientist, Sales at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

- Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

- Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

title: People Operations Manager (Antwerp)
description:
ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/3519e886-495e-4d41-8a3b-439b2a607aea/pictures.jpg]

THE CONTEXT

Conveo is scaling from $4M to $50M, and the People team is running on goodwill and late nights. We have a recruiting team and a new L&D hire joining, but nobody owns the processes and systems underneath them. Compensation schemes, performance cycles and salary reviews all land on Claudia, alongside the daily operational load.

That has to change before we grow further. You'll be the first dedicated People Operations hire, reporting to Claudia. You'll build the operating system for the whole People function: the tools, data, cycles and lifecycle processes that let us hire, pay, develop and support people well across the UK, Belgium and the US.

You'll work closely with Finance on payroll and compensation, with recruiting and L&D on the employee lifecycle, and with managers across the company. When you've done this well, Claudia spends her time on strategy and growing the team, not on firefighting.

YOUR MISSION

1. OWN THE PEOPLE SYSTEMS STACK AND MAKE IT WORK ACROSS EVERY COUNTRY

You decide how our People tools fit together, then make them run. Today that spans an HRIS, EOR and PEO providers, and payroll across several geographies.

- Own the HRIS as the single source of truth for every employee, contractor and EOR hire

- Lead a possible payroll migration end to end: vendor choice, data cleanup, parallel runs, cutover

- Manage EOR and PEO relationships across the UK, Belgium and the US

- Connect systems so data flows once, not through spreadsheets and copy-paste

- Use AI and automation to remove manual admin wherever it adds no judgement

2. BUILD AN EMPLOYEE LIFECYCLE THAT FEELS EFFORTLESS AT 2X OUR SIZE

Every hire, move and exit should follow a clear, repeatable path that works in any country we operate in.

- Design onboarding, internal moves and offboarding flows with recruiting and L&D

- Turn tribal knowledge into documented processes and self-serve answers

- Keep contracts, documents and policies consistent across geographies

- Make the experience good for employees and managers, not just compliant

3. RUN THE PEOPLE CYCLES THE COMPANY DEPENDS ON

Performance reviews, compensation and salary increases should run on time, every time, without pulling Claudia into the detail.

- Own the performance cycle calendar, tooling and manager enablement

- Run compensation projects and salary review cycles with Claudia and Finance

- Keep bands, levels and approvals applied consistently

- Spot what slowed each cycle down and fix it before the next one

4. TURN PEOPLE DATA INTO DECISIONS

Leadership should be able to answer people questions in minutes, with numbers they trust.

- Build reliable reporting on headcount, attrition, compensation and cycle completion

- Keep People data clean enough to support planning and board reporting

- Give Claudia and managers the insight to act early, not after the fact

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

MUST-HAVES

- 5+ years in People Operations, including time at a startup or scaleup through hypergrowth, with hands-on experience across multiple countries (ideally Belgium and the UK)

- Hands-on experience scaling a People function: you've seen what breaks between 50 and 200+ people and helped fix it

- Strong systems thinking: you design processes and tool stacks that hold up as the company grows, not one-off fixes

- Hands-on experience implementing an HRIS (Deel is a big plus) and running at least one people cycle (performance, comp review or onboarding) end to end.

- Comfort working with data: you can build a report leadership trusts, and you notice when the numbers look wrong
